## [1.0.0-dev.2](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.1...v1.0.0-dev.2) (2026-10-09)

### ✨ New Features

* Add "Block forced updates" patch ([#3](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/issues/3)) ([c77c5de](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/commit/c77c5de46e1729d7bb15ff23185c344ad009463a))

patches.name: Block forced updates
patches.description: Disables Google Play in-app update prompts and makes 'Update required' messages dismissible, so the patched app can't be locked out by a forced update.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Makes the app behave as if all tracking consent was declined, so Braze, Datadog, Red Bull analytics, GfK and Datazoom never start and Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics don't collect data.

patches.name: Disable video ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll and mid-roll ads (Google IMA) from videos and live channels.
